# d3-dsv

Unmodified `src/dsv.js` from d3-dsv 3.0.1, stored as `dsv.mjs` for shared browser/Node.js imports.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-dsv@3.0.1/src/dsv.js

License: ISC; see LICENSE. Only `dsvFormat(',').parseRows` is used. Vendored to avoid a new runtime CDN dependency and support offline loading.
